source: 724 Leader
target: 724 Dux

source: The Purifier team from Saint Viève Cathedral soon arrived at Moran Avigny’s study, carrying a nearly sealed wooden box.
target: Turma Purificatorum ex Cathedrali Sanctae Viève mox ad studio Moran Avigny pervenit, ferens arcam ligneam paene clausam.

source: They each wore white robes adorned with waxed golden threads, thin rubber gloves, and leather hoods.
target: Singuli induebantur vestibus albis ornatis filis aureis ceratis, manicis tenuibus ex caucho, et cucullis ex corio.

source: Their masks curved downward, forming a bird’s beak in front of their mouths and noses.
target: Larvae eorum deorsum curvabantur, formantes rostrum avis ante ora et nares.

source: Angoulême signaled the other Purifiers to withdraw from this floor and clear the adjacent ones.
target: Angoulême aliis Purificatoribus signum dedit ut a hoc tabulato discederent et tabulata vicina expellerent.

source: Donning a bird-beak mask and similar attire himself, he tightly bandaged his wrists and ankles.
target: Se ipse, larvam cum rostri avis similem atque vestimenta similia induens, carpus et tarsos arcte ligavit.

source: Peering through the red glass lenses of his mask, Angoulême watched his colleagues open the wooden box.
target: Intuentem per vitrea rubra lentibus larvae suae, Angoulême spectavit collegas suos arcam ligneam aperire.

source: Mirrors of the perfect size lined the inner layer of the box on all sides—top, bottom, left, right, front, and back.
target: Specula perfectae mensurae interiorem arcae ex omnibus partibus repleverunt—superius, inferius, sinistrum, dextrum, anterius, et posterius.

source: In the center, surrounded by the mirrors, stood a milky-white stone statue half the height of a person.
target: In medio, speculis circumdata, stabat statua lapidea albo lactea dimidia altitudinis hominis.

source: It portrayed a beautiful half-naked woman, her dress torn away to the waist.
target: Illud repraesentabat formosam mulierem semi-nudam, cuius vestis usque ad lumbos disrupta erat.

source: Despite the female figurine’s broken arm, her other hand alluringly covered her navel.
target: Quamquam brachium fractum figurae feminae erat, altera manus eius venuste umbilicum tegebat.

source: Her captivating figure and exquisite facial features stirred an inexplicable heat within Angoulême.
target: Figura eius captiva et lineamenta vultuum exquisita ignem inexplicabilem in Angoulême excitaverunt.

source: A sudden urge to kiss “her” flooded his mind, a desire for an intimate encounter with the stone statue.
target: Subito impulsus eam osculari mentem eius inundavit, desiderium congressus intimi cum statua lapidea.

source: Not daring to breathe deeply, he forced himself to maintain control.
target: Non ausus alte spirare, se coegit ut temperantiam retineret.

source: He recognized this as a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact under the Trier diocese, serial number 82, known as the Ullamos Statue.
target: Agnovit hoc esse Artefactum Sigillatum Gradus 1 sub dioecesi Trevirensi, numero serii 82, quod Statua Ullamos nominatur.

source: This Grade 1 Sealed Artifact could gradually entice nearby creatures to obsess over it, spreading various illnesses, some common and others mystical in nature.
target: Hoc Artefactum Sigillatum Gradus 1 paulatim poterat attrahere creaturas proximas ad eius obsessionem, diffundens varias morbos, quosdam vulgares, alias mysticos.

source: Left unchecked, the statue’s influence would transform its surroundings into a nightmarish landscape of agony—living beings wailing, writhing, and perishing in horrifying ways.
target: Sine coercitione, potentia statuae circumiecta in regionem somniorum dolori transformaret, ubi entia viva gemebant, contorti erant atque in horribili modo peribant.

source: The relentless plague would expand, unleashing a widening catastrophe.
target: Plaga implacabilis se dilatabitur, erupiens calamitatem crescente.

source: Angoulême had requested 1-82 for its ability to guide other creatures into the mirror world.
target: Angoulême petiverat 1-82, cuius potentia erat alias creaturas in mundum specularum ducere.

source: Strictly controlling exposure time was crucial to prevent the spread of illness and obsession.
target: Temporis expositionis stricta moderatio necessaria erat ad diffusionem morborum et obsessionis impediendam.

source: The two Purifiers gently lifted the Ullamos Statue and carried it to the full-body mirror in the study.
target: Duo Purificatores statuam Ullamos leniter sustulerunt et eam ad speculum totius corporis in studio portaverunt.

source: Angoulême and his two other teammates approached, placing their palms on 1-82’s shoulders.
target: Angoulême et duo ceteri sodales accesserunt, pandentes manus suas super umeros 1-82.

source: In perfect synchronicity, they magically phased through the glass mirror, vanishing from Moran Avigny’s study.
target: In perfecta synchronia, per speculum vitreum magice transluxerunt, evanescentes e studio Moran Avigny.

source: As soon as Angoulême laid eyes on the dark, hazy, almost illusory space behind the mirror, a tickle in his throat urged him to cough.
target: Statim ut Angoulême intuens spatium obscurum, nebulosum, fere illusorium post speculum cepit, titillatio in gutture eum ad tussim incitavit.

source: “Sigh…” A soft exhalation escaped his lips.
target: «Suspirum…» exhalatio levis ex labris eius effugit.

source: Their attire couldn’t isolate the disease spread by the Ullamos Statue…
target: Indumenta eorum morbum, quem Statua Ullamos diffundebat, isolare non poterant…

source: Its sole purpose was to minimize the rate at which they succumbed to genuine infection!
target: Unicum propositum eius erat minuere celeritatem qua verae infectioni succumbebant!

source: Weakened yet inexplicably excited, Angoulême and his teammates investigated the area behind the mirror.
target: Debiles sed inexplicabiliter excitati, Angoulême et sodales eius exploraverunt regionem post speculum.

source: They quickly discovered numerous dim mirror fragments scattered about.
target: Celeriter invenērunt plura fragmenta speculi tenebrosa dispersa.

source: “A battle took place here. Moran Avigny had to use Mirror Substitution multiple times, but there’s no sign of blood, bodily fluids, hair, or any other traces,” one of the Purifiers concluded.
target: «Pugna hic orta est. Moran Avigny substitutionem speculi pluries adhibere debitum habuit, sed signum sanguinis, fluidorum corporis, capillorum aut aliorum vestigiis non apparuit,» unus ex Purificatoribus conclusit.

source: Angoulême’s heart raced as he speculated.
target: Cor Angoulême celeriter pulsabat, dum speculabatur.

source: A battle? Someone ambushed Moran Avigny in the mirror?
target: Pugna? Aliquis Moran Avigny in speculo insidiatus est?

source: Impressive, Hidden Blade!
target: Impressionans, Lamina Occulta!

source: “I see. The Aurora Order never expected the assassination to succeed. The assassin’s only objective was to drive Moran Avigny into this mirror, where the rest of the Aurora Order awaited him!”
target: «Intelligo. Ordo Aurorae numquam exspectavit ut caedes succederet. Solum propositum sicarii fuit impellere Moran Avigny in hunc speculum, ubi reliqui Ordine Aurorae eum exspectabant!»

source: The other Purifiers concurred with this theory, nodding in agreement.
target: Reliqui Purificatores huic theoriae consenserunt, annuentes.

source: “Definitely the Aurora Order.”
target: «Profecto, Ordo Aurorae.»

source: “They even utilized a potent item capable of accessing the mirror world to confront Moran Avigny.”
target: «Etiam rem potentem, quae aditum in mundum specularum praebere posset, ad Moran Avigny oppugnandum usi sunt.»

source: “The absence of gruesome scenes suggests the Aurora Order aimed to capture Moran Avigny alive and extract vital information.”
target: «Inopia scaenarum horrendorum significat Ordinem Aurorae conatum esse Moran Avigny vivum capere atque informationes vitales extrahere.»

source: “Over the past five to six years, the Aurora Order has grown more intelligent…”
target: «Per annos quinque ad sex, Ordo Aurorae magis callidus factus est…»

source: Following a short discussion, one of the Purifiers glanced back at the Ullamos Statue at the entrance and gulped.
target: Post brevem disputationem, unus ex Purificatoribus retrospexit ad Statua Ullamos ad introitum et deglutivit.

source: “We need to leave now. Return 1-82 to the mirror box. I can’t endure it any longer.”
target: «Nunc discedere debemus. Redi 1-82 ad arcam specularum. Diutius id sustinere non possum.»

source: Angoulême agreed.
target: Angoulême consentivit.

source: Back in the real world, they sealed 1-82 once more and removed their cumbersome attire.
target: In mundo vero, 1-82 iterum sigillarunt et indumenta onerosa removerunt.

source: At last, he sighed with relief, feeling utterly exhausted in both body and mind.
target: Denique levitatione suspiravit, se corpore et mente plane exhaustum sentiens.

source: Inside the quarry cave with a stable mirror world entrance, illuminated by the carbide lamp under the Eye of Calamity’s gaze, Moran Avigny smiled as he answered Lumian’s question,
target: Intra speluncam fodinae cum stabilis ingresso in mundum specularum, luce lampadis carbidicae sub aspectu Oculi Calamitatis, Moran Avigny subridet dum quaestioni Luminiani respondebat.

source: “Also through a mirror.”
target: «Etiam per speculum.»

source: While speaking, he retrieved a makeup mirror from his pocket and elaborated, “Every mirror in the mirror world is unique, each with its own corresponding coordinates.
target: Dum loquebatur, speculum pulchrum ex sinu extraxit et enarrauit: “Omne speculum in mundo specularum singulare est, et cuique propriae coordinatae tribuantur.

source: I provided him with my mirror’s coordinates, and he reciprocated with the coordinates of a mirror on his side.
target: Ei dedi coordinatas speculi mei, et ille reddidit coordinatas speculi ipsius.

source: With this arrangement, I can harness my abilities and the mirror world to transmit information to his mirror for a set duration.
target: His conditionibus, facultates meas et mundum specularum adhibere possum ut informationes in speculum eius per tempus statutum transmittam.

source: He contacts me in the same manner but relies on the Beyonder item I gave him.
target: Eodem modo me contingit, sed innititur re “Beyonder” quam ei dedi.

source: “An IP address, I suppose…” Franca muttered in a language unfamiliar to anyone present.
target: «Forsitan indicem IP,» Franca murmuravit in lingua omnibus praesentibus ignota.

source: Lumian smiled warmly and inquired, “Would you be willing to share the Overseer’s mirror coordinates with us?”
target: Lumian calide subridens inquit, “Velisne coordinatas speculi Overseeris nobiscum communicare?”

source: Moran Avigny shook his head.
target: Moran Avigny caput negavit.

source: “It’s indescribable and impossible to write down. Only those like us from the mirror world can perceive it. Or Demonesses with godhood—Demonesses of Despair.”
target: «Indescribibile est atque scribere impossibile. Soli similes nobis ex mundo specularum id percipere possunt. Vel Demonissae cum deitate—Demonissae Desperationis.»

source: Sequence 4 Demoness of Despair? And Sequence 5 is Demoness of Affliction… These two Sequences sound unpleasant. Uncomfortable to act, but the subsequent Demoness of Unaging is quite impressive… Franca gleaned information about the Demoness pathway from Moran Avigny’s words.
target: «Series IV: Demonissa Desperationis? Et Series V: Demonissa Afflictionis… Hae duae series inhoneste sonant. Incommodum sunt ad agendum, sed sequens Demonissa Sine Senectute valde mirabilis est…» Franca ex verbis Moran Avigny notitiam de via Demonissarum colliguit.

source: “How can the Overseer perceive it then?” Jenna asked.
target: «Quomodo ergo Overseer id percipere potest?» Jenna rogavit.

source: Moran Avigny smiled.
target: Moran Avigny subridit.

source: “He can’t perceive it either, but his Beyonder item can record and use it.”
target: «Nec ipse id percipere potest, sed eius res “Beyonder” potest id recordari et adhiberi.»

source: Franca smiled and raised her sleeve, revealing the glass-like Mirror Cufflink.
target: Franca subridens, manica sua extulit, ostendens fibulam speculi quasi vitrei.

source: Taken aback, Moran Avigny’s expression shifted to one of relief.
target: Moran Avigny, obstupefactus, vultum suum in expressionem levationis mutavit.

source: “You’re the ones who killed Jebus.”
target: «Vos estis qui Jebus occidistis.»

source: “The Overseer killed him,” Lumian clarified sincerely. “We had no intention of killing him. We even wanted to befriend him, but the Overseer used a mysterious power from afar to end his life. I fear you may suffer the same fate.”
target: «Overseer illum occidit,» Lumian sincere declaravit. «Nolumus eum interficere; etiam amicitiam cum eo petivimus, sed Overseer vi arcana ex longinquo ad finem vitae eius usus est. Timeo ne eandem sortem subeatis.»

source: Moran Avigny fell silent for a few moments before stating, “It can record it.”
target: Moran Avigny paululum tacebat, deinde dixit: “Id recordare potest.”

source: He referred to the Mirror Cufflink’s ability to record the Overseer mirror’s coordinates.
target: Ad facultatem fibulae speculi recordandi coordinatas speculi Overseeris refert.

source: Franca wasn’t surprised at all. “I knew it would work.”
target: Franca minime mirata est. «Sciebam id operaturum esse.»

source: When she had used the Mirror Cufflink earlier, she realized the mirrors in the mirror world gave her a crystal-clear sense of the mirror world’s entrances in the vicinity.
target: Cum antea Mirror Cufflink usus esset, intellexit specula in mundo specularum ei perspicuam notionem de ingressibus in vicinitate praebere.

source: There was the full-body mirror in Moran Avigny’s study and a few other unknown mirrors.
target: Erat speculum totius corporis in studio Moran Avigny et quaedam alia specula ignota.

source: Franca suspected the Mirror Cufflink would instinctively record the corresponding coordinates of each mirror.
target: Franca suspicabatur Mirror Cufflink instinctive recordaturum esse coordinatas correspondentis cuiusque speculi.

source: Moran Avigny continued, “You won’t be able to find the Overseer directly through that mirror.
target: Moran Avigny continuavit: “Non potestis directe per illum speculum Overseeris invenire.

source: I’ve long suspected the mirror is actually with one of the Overseer’s subordinates.
target: Diu suspicatus sum speculum revera cum uno subordinatorum Overseeris esse.

source: Naturally, that subordinate must be very close to the Overseer. Otherwise, it would hinder the transmission of information.
target: Naturaliter, ille subordinator valde prope Overseer esse debet; alioquin transmissionem informationum impediat.

source: Just like many members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, the contact points reserved for Madame Hela’s messenger are isolated from their real lives…
target: Sicut multi membra Societatis Investigationis Simiae Crispis, loca contactus pro nuntio Madame Hela reserata sunt, ab vita reali segregata…

source: Lumian nodded slightly and said, “That’s not an issue. We can visit them one by one, as long as they’re truly close.
target: Lumian leviter annuavit et dixit, “Non est quaestio; eos visitare possumus singulatim, dummodo vere prope sint.

source: Can you provide us with those coordinates?”
target: Potestisne nobis praebere has coordinatas?”

source: Moran Avigny fell silent.
target: Moran Avigny tacebat.

source: The effects of hypnosis and truth serum battled fiercely against his resolve.
target: Effectus hypnosi et serei veritatis vehementer contra eius voluntatem pugnabant.

source: This was a Disciplinary Paladin’s principle and corresponding restrictions.
target: Haec erant praecepta Paladini Disciplinarii et restrictiones correspondentes.

source: Observing the shifts in his fate tributary, Lumian smiled and said, “You can think it over. Let’s discuss something else first.”
target: Observans conversiones in cursu fatali eius, Lumian subridens dixit: “Hoc considerare potes. Prius aliquid aliud disseramus.”

source: Having witnessed Moran Avigny’s potential loss of control, he intended to inquire about other information.
target: Cum testimonium ceperit de potestate Moran Avigny amittendae, aliis informationibus rogare intendebat.

source: If the other party refused to divulge it later, he would kill him before channeling his spirit!
target: Si altera pars postea recusaverit ea enarrare, eum occideret antequam spiritum eius dirigeret!

source: “Very well.” Moran Avigny let out a lengthy sigh.
target: «Ita,» Moran Avigny subridit. «Numquam coniectabis quis sit.»

source: Lumian pondered briefly and asked,
target: Lumian breviter meditatus rogavit:

source: “What deals did the Overseer make with you?”
target: «Quae commercia tibi fecit Overseer?»

source: Moran Avigny responded nonchalantly, “Primarily providing assistance to certain individuals.
target: Moran Avigny nonchalance respondit: “Præsertim quibusdam hominibus auxilium praebens,

source: In turn, I received help through the Overseer.
target: converso, auxilium per Overseer accepi.

source: Consequently, we elevated our political status and acquired more resources.
target: Consequenter, statum politicum nostrum extollimus et plura subsidia consecuti sumus.

source: “This is a common practice among politicians, but with the Overseer, it’s even more covert, less detectable, and effective.
target: «Hoc consuetudo est inter políticos, sed cum Overseer, multo latior, minus detegibilis, et efficax,

source: Additionally, protecting specific individuals or indirectly granting benefits to non-high society members to fulfill the requirements on the other side of the Overseer’s Under the Table transaction.
target: praeterea, ut singulos certos protegere vel indirecte membris ex parte humiliori beneficia tribuere possimus ad exigentias altera parte transactionis “sub mensa” Overseeris implendas.

source: Lumian considered for a moment and asked, “Didn’t that Overseer communicate with the leader of your Mirror People?”
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus rogavit: “Num ille Overseer non communicavit cum duce Populi Specularum vestri?”

source: Unsure if the Mirror People had a de facto leader, he said this to deceive Moran Avigny, implying they already possessed important information.
target: Nescio num Populus Specularum ducem de facto haberet, dixit hoc ut Moran Avigny falleret, insinuans eos iam informationes importantes habere.

source: If the Mirror People truly lacked a de facto leader, Moran Avigny would see through the deception. With the truth serum and hypnosis, this wouldn’t affect his subsequent answers.
target: Si revera Populus Specularum ducem de facto carebat, Moran Avigny deciperet. Cum sereo veritatis et hypnosi, id responsa eius posteriora non afficiet.

source: Moran Avigny’s expression shifted slightly. “He did communicate with our leader.”
target: Vultus Moran Avigny leviter mutatus est. “Ille cum duce nostro communicavit.”

source: “How did they communicate?” Lumian asked calmly.
target: “Quomodo communicaverunt?” Lumian tranquillo modo rogavit.

source: “Through a provided ritual. I don’t know what was exchanged as I wasn’t present,” Moran Avigny replied honestly.
target: “Per ritum praebitum; nescio quid commutatum fuisset, quoniam non adfui,” Moran Avigny honestiter respondit.

source: Franca asked curiously, “Is your leader in the real world or the mirror world of Fourth Epoch Trier?”
target: Franca curiose rogavit: “Num dux tuus est in mundo reali aut in mundo specularum Aevi Quarti Trevirensis?”

source: “In Fourth Epoch Trier,” Moran Avigny said with a sigh. “Mirror People with powerful godhood can’t escape through certain catastrophes via the leakage point.”
target: “In Aevo Quarti Trevirensis,” Moran Avigny suspirans dixit. “Populi Specularum cum deitate potenti non possunt per quaedam calamitates, per punctum effusionis, evadere.”

source: Franca pondered for a moment and asked, “Does your leader have a corresponding self in reality?”
target: Franca paulisper meditata rogavit: “Habesne dux tuus seipsum correspondantem in mundo reali?”

source: “Yes.” Moran Avigny smiled. “You’ll never guess who it is.”
target: “Ita,” Moran Avigny subridit. “Numquam coniectabis quis sit.”
